requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key

narrative.summary: Comet.governor(), the owner of the proxy admin and the Configurator’s governor all resolve to one Compound Timelock (2-day delay, which is also its floor) answering to the Compound Governor. The bypass found is a 5-of-9 Safe, the pauseGuardian, that can pause supply, transfer, withdraw, absorb and buy instantly.
narrative.tag: $1.36B TVL (all Compound V3 markets on Ethereum)
narrative.detail: The pauseGuardian Safe (no module, no guard) is also the Governor’s proposalGuardian and whitelistGuardian, so it can cancel proposals; its instant pause is a freeze (availability) power, not a fund-redirect one, which is why timelockScore is 60 rather than Uniswap’s 75.

steps.what: the admin slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the word is the admin address
owner() on the address the slot returned (a ProxyAdmin): the holder
delay() on the holder (Compound-style timelock), in seconds
the implementation slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the code behind it, an upgrade changes this word

independent_read_reproduce.curl:
# the admin slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the word is the admin address
curl -s -X POST https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getStorageAt","params":["0xc3d688b66703497daa19211eedff47f25384cdc3","0xb53127684a568b3173ae13b9f8a6016e243e63b6e8ee1178d6a717850b5d6103","latest"]}'
# owner() on the address the slot returned (a ProxyAdmin): the holder
curl -s -X POST https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"<address from the slot>","data":"0x8da5cb5b"},"latest"]}'
# delay() on the holder (Compound-style timelock), in seconds
curl -s -X POST https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"0x6d903f6003cca6255d85cca4d3b5e5146dc33925","data":"0x6a42b8f8"},"latest"]}'
# the implementation slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the code behind it, an upgrade changes this word
curl -s -X POST https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getStorageAt","params":["0xc3d688b66703497daa19211eedff47f25384cdc3","0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc","latest"]}'
